findings.title: Synology-SA-24:20 DSM (PWN2OWN 2024)
findings.summary_md: Synology published advisory Synology_SA_24_20 on 2024-11-05 covering DSM and BeeStation OS flaws, including CVE-2024-10441, an improper certificate validation issue in the update functionality rated CVSS 9.8. The advisory lists fixed DSM builds 6.2.4-25556-8, 7.1.1-42962-7, 7.2-64570-4, 7.2.1-69057-6 and 7.2.2-72806-1 or above, and states no mitigation.

findings.title: Synology-SA-26:13 DSM
findings.summary_md: Synology published security advisory Synology_SA_26_13 on 2026-09-18 and rated it Critical. It addresses eight DSM vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-13684 (improper output encoding in the SCGI component) and CVE-2026-13639 (insufficient entropy in login logic), both allowing remote unauthenticated attackers to read or write arbitrary files and cause denial of service. Fixed DSM releases are 7.2.1-69057-12, 7.2.2-72806-9, 7.3.2-86009-4 and 7.4-90075 or above, and Synology lists no mitigation other than updating.
